resources.name: CrystalNet
resources.inputs_target: PXRD + composition information → electron density / structure
resources.method: Coordinate-based VAE for electron density
resources.reported_performance: Up to 93.4% SSIM on cubic test cases; 74.1% average SSIM on trigonal cases

resources.name: Crystalyze
resources.method: End-to-end PXRD-to-CIF pipeline

resources.name: XtalNet
resources.inputs_target: PXRD + composition / MOF setting → crystal structure candidates
resources.method: Contrastive PXRD-crystal pretraining + conditional equivariant diffusion
resources.reported_performance: Top-10 match rate: 90.2% on hMOF-100 and 79% on hMOF-400

resources.name: PXRDnet
resources.inputs_target: Formula + finite-size-broadened PXRD → atomic structure candidates
resources.method: SE(3)-equivariant score-based diffusion; post-Rietveld verification
resources.reported_performance: Verifiable candidates for simulated nanocrystals in ~4/5 cases; average post-Rietveld R factor ~7%; median RMSD ≤0.11 Å in reported benchmarks

resources.name: PXRDGen
resources.inputs_target: PXRD + optional composition constraints → structure candidates
resources.method: Pretrained XRD encoder + diffusion/flow generator + automatic Rietveld refinement
resources.reported_performance: MP-20: 82% valid compounds from 1 sample; 96% within 20 samples

resources.name: deCIFer
resources.method: Autoregressive Transformer / CIF language modeling
resources.artifact_note: The 2026 experimental evaluation reports recovery of known Si and CeO2 structures, while lower-symmetry Fe2O3 and nanocrystalline CeO2 expose expected limits; this is a four-case diagnostic, not a broad experimental success rate

resources.name: DiffractGPT
resources.inputs_target: PXRD-conditioned text generation → CIF-like crystal descriptions
resources.method: Large-token GPT / AtomGPT-style generative model
resources.reported_performance: DGPT-formula lattice MAE: 0.17 / 0.18 / 0.27 Å for a/b/c; normalized RMS-d 0.07 Å

resources.name: Uni3DAR
resources.method: Hierarchical tokenization + 3D autoregressive generation
resources.reported_performance: MP-20 PXRD-guided CSP: 75.08% match rate, 0.0276 RMSE

resources.name: AGAPI-XRD
resources.inputs_target: Experimental or simulated PXRD + optional composition/formula constraints → candidate and refined crystal structure
resources.method: Hybrid DiffractGPT generation, JARVIS-DFT/COD pattern matching, optional ALIGNN-FF relaxation, and automated GSAS-II/BGMN Rietveld refinement
resources.reported_performance: RRUFF (276 minerals with a,b,c ≤10 Å): candidate returned for 93.8% and valid lattice parameters for 79.7%; Alexandria 1,000-structure subset: 94.8–98.1% valid lattice-parameter return, but 229/1,000 StructureMatcher matches in the no-refinement run
resources.artifact_note: The paper-linked AtomGPTLab repository is now available with benchmark scripts, manuscript source, and dataset files; it declares no repository license and full reproduction requires an AGAPI key plus external crystallographic tools and databases

resources.name: CrystaLLM-π
resources.inputs_target: Pre-picked PXRD peak positions/intensities + composition and unit-cell stoichiometry → CIF candidates
resources.method: Autoregressive CIF language model with residual-attention PXRD conditioning and perplexity ranking
resources.reported_performance: MP-20: 62.73% conditional match for one perplexity-ranked candidate (RMSD 0.0444 Å); JARVIS-DFT: 85.47% best-of-20 consistent match (RMSD 0.0361 Å)

resources.name: CrySTARNet
resources.inputs_target: PXRD + composition, with optional TEM → crystal structure with fractional occupancies
resources.method: Contrastive XRD/TEM representation learning + conditional diffusion generation + diffraction-based candidate screening
resources.reported_performance: Repository/Zenodo claim: over 85% top-10 match accuracy across six structure families, with several families above 95%; no paper or independent validation was found
resources.artifact_note: No paper or preprint was found during the 2026-08-24 pass; performance is reported only by the official repository and Zenodo record

resources.name: Xrd2Mof
resources.inputs_target: PXRD + metal-node and organic-linker priors → atomic MOF structure
resources.method: Stable-Diffusion framework with a coarse-grained MOF representation and atomic assembly
resources.reported_performance: Over 93% accuracy identifying the ground-truth MOF corresponding to a target XRD pattern in the author-reported setting
resources.artifact_note: MIT source is public; the current README directs full-data requests to the authors. Training structures originate from CSD, whose access terms apply; the September repository update changes installation instructions, not the published performance claim

resources.name: XRDSol
resources.inputs_target: Stoichiometry + unit cell + PXRD → atomic coordinates
resources.method: Equivariant graph neural network diffusion model
resources.reported_performance: MP-20: 82.3% success; ICDD-20 experimental benchmark: 81.6%; ~0.6 s per solution on one GPU

resources.name: RealPXRD-Solver
resources.inputs_target: Experimental or simulated PXRD, with lattice-conditioned and lattice-free modes → crystal structure
resources.method: Flow-matching / generative solver using d-I fingerprints and experiment-mimicking augmentation
resources.reported_performance: Theoretical benchmark: 98.3% top-20; CNRS experimental: 77.9% top-1 / 91.9% top-20 with lattice conditioning; RRUFF: 78.8% / 92.9%; solved 39 previously unreported PDF entries

resources.name: Ab-PXRD-Solver
resources.inputs_target: Experimental PXRD + chemical formula, with an optional known space group → refined CIF
resources.method: Hybrid discrete symmetry/cell/Wyckoff search and continuous coordinate optimization with ML and physics-informed refinement
resources.reported_performance: Authors provide systematic results for more than 1,000 systems and demonstrations on complex or noisy experimental cases

resources.name: XRDiff
resources.inputs_target: PXRD + stoichiometry, or elements + total atom count → crystal structure
resources.method: Diffusion model with full-spectrum or peak-descriptor PXRD conditioning
resources.reported_performance: Peak-based conditioning generalized substantially better to experimental PXRD than full-spectrum conditioning, including a full-spectrum model with fitted noise augmentation
resources.artifact_note: code/data not found during the 2026-10-05 verification pass

resources.name: AlphaDiffract
resources.task: Crystal system, space group, and lattice parameter prediction from PXRD
resources.method: 1D ConvNeXt / deep diffraction encoder
resources.reported_result: Trained on >31M simulated patterns from 312,267 ICSD + Materials Project structures; RRUFF experimental benchmark: 81.7% crystal-system and 66.2% space-group accuracy in the paper

resources.name: Invariant lattice-bispectrum predictor
resources.task: Unit-cell parameter prediction from simulated or experimental PXRD
resources.method: Transformer prediction of an E(3)-invariant reciprocal-lattice bispectrum followed by dynamic-programming/gradient inversion to lattice vectors
resources.reported_result: On MP-20 with the same model architecture, the paper reports length MAPE decreasing from 11.18% to 2.44% and angle MAPE from 12.74% to 3.07% versus direct lattice-parameter prediction
resources.artifact_note: MIT source includes the training/evaluation and bispectrum-inversion code, tests, and exact split IDs. Datasets, trained checkpoints, and inversion results are not bundled and must be supplied separately

resources.name: PhiGen
resources.task: Phase prediction from indexed powder-derived structure-factor amplitudes with a known unit cell and space group; not raw-profile PXRD-to-structure inference
resources.method: Invariant-constrained generative phase prediction using a separately trained 3 Å zeolite powder branch, followed by Superflip phase extension; the experimental workflow obtains amplitudes by Le Bail fitting
resources.reported_result: On 1,854 held-out simulated 3 Å zeolite powder datasets with modelled reflection overlap, the preprint reports 84.2% framework-map recovery at CC >= 0.7 versus 1.0% for Superflip. Experimental ZSM-25 and TNU-9 are phase-seeding demonstrations; one of 4 and one of 40 seeds, respectively, led to recovery after phase extension, and the paper does not establish reference-free selection of the successful seed. The broader 210-space-group results use calculated 1 Å reflections and are not powder evidence. The main text does not state whether the zeolite success rate uses best-of-N reference selection, and the supplement was not inspected
resources.artifact_note: The preprint states that code and datasets will be available after publication; no public implementation or model release was verified on 2026-10-05

resources.name: HyPhID
resources.task: Crystal-system and space-group classification from one-dimensional simulated powder XRD patterns, with ranked phase retrieval and explanations
resources.method: Convolutional autoencoder/classifier with latent retrieval, Integrated Gradients similarity, and composition-embedding evidence aggregation
resources.reported_result: The preprint reports 98.85% crystal-system and 95.82% 22-space-group accuracy on an internal synthetic holdout, decreasing to 81.07% and 56.13% on 750 augmented patterns generated from 50 RRUFF CIFs; this is RRUFF-derived simulation, not raw measured-profile evaluation
resources.artifact_note: The paper-linked repository supplies code and notebooks but excludes large datasets and intermediate outputs. Its README claims LGPL-3.0, but no LICENSE file or repository-detected license was present; the linked Zenodo record was not publicly registered on 2026-10-05

resources.name: ChatXRD
resources.task: Crystal-system classification and lattice prediction from extracted PXRD peak positions, not raw experimental profiles
resources.method: GPT-5 agent with decision-tree tool selection and self-attention-decayed transformer classifiers/regressors
resources.reported_result: Authors report up to 97.3% classification accuracy and lattice R^2 of 0.88-0.99 on simulated/curated peak data; classifier results select the best of seven split seeds, distinct from the 150-sample agent evaluation
resources.artifact_note: The CC-BY-4.0 Zenodo record publishes data.zip; archive contents were not downloaded in this audit. No separate official source-code or checkpoint release was found as of 2026-09-21; experimental peak extraction remains a stated limitation

resources.name: GALAXI
resources.task: Single- and multi-phase identification from PXRD against a supplied reference-structure library
resources.method: Independent phase-specific binary CNN screening followed by Dara multiple-hypothesis Rietveld refinement
resources.reported_result: Preprint reports group-level micro-F1 = 0.935 after refinement on 61 pristine experimental patterns (365 CIFs grouped into 317 profile-similarity classes); not exact-CIF recovery or a test over the 64,594-structure hosted library
resources.artifact_note: MIT source and example weights are public; the complete hosted weight library was not verified downloadable. The advertised service remained unverifiable from the audit network on 2026-10-05 because HTTPS clients failed during connection setup. The paper's refinement stage uses Dara/BGMN; pretrained examples require a 5-105 degree, 7001-point grid

resources.name: XQueryer
resources.task: Neural search-match / structure identification from PXRD
resources.method: Fourier transform, CNN feature extraction, cross-attention, real-time diffractometer integration
resources.reported_result: Simulated database: >2M patterns from 100,315 Materials Project structures; experimental RRUFF-MP benchmark: ~70.3% accuracy reported

resources.name: XMatcher
resources.task: Interpretable single- and multi-phase search-match identification from experimental PXRD
resources.method: Composition-filtered theoretical-library retrieval, bounded global 2θ shift, one-to-one peak assignment, and AutoMix non-negative mixture fitting
resources.reported_result: The official archive provides Desktop v1.3.0 Windows/macOS packages and reports 2,007 added RRUFF structures; AutoMix weights are diffraction-evidence contributions, not quantitative phase fractions
resources.artifact_note: The formerly official GitHub repository still returned 404 on repeated web/API checks on 2026-10-05; no replacement source repository was verified. The Figshare archive remains available and labels its deposit CC-BY-4.0

resources.name: XCCP
resources.task: Contrastive PXRD-candidate matching and space-group identification
resources.method: Dual-expert PXRD/candidate encoder with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network components
resources.reported_result: Top-1 structure retrieval: 46.42% without elemental priors; 88.98% with elemental pre-screening; space-group accuracy up to 93.39% with composition filtering
resources.artifact_note: No public source code was verified on 2026-10-05

resources.name: AIdex-R2
resources.task: Powder-pattern indexing: extinction-group and unit-cell inference from low-angle reflections
resources.method: Transformer joint prediction of extinction groups and cell parameters from reflection sequences
resources.reported_result: The paper reports ~98.5% top-5 extinction-group accuracy, ~1.44% cell-parameter MAPE, and >90% indexing success under its strongest combined perturbation benchmark

paper_links.label: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

resources.artifact_note: public code, weights, and benchmark data not found during the 2026-10-05 verification pass

resources.name: MatDiffract
resources.task: Automated single- and multi-phase identification, refinement, and quantification from PXRD
resources.method: Atomly-derived simulated library + multiscale vector retrieval + full-pattern Rietveld refinement and quantitative phase fitting
resources.reported_result: 875 single-phase experimental patterns: 91.3% top-1 and 97.2% top-10 after refinement; binary/ternary mixtures: 85.0%/70.0% top-1 with 1.2%/1.8% mass-fraction MAE
resources.artifact_note: The public analysis service was available, but no verified official source-code or benchmark-data release was found during the 2026-10-05 pass; the same-name data repository first seen in September still could not be attributed to the authors

resources.name: RADAR-PD
resources.task: Automated phase identification and quantification for X-ray and neutron powder diffraction
resources.method: Coarse-Q neural candidate screening + lattice nudging + staged GSAS-II Rietveld verification
resources.reported_result: On a curated 291-pattern RRUFF PXRD benchmark, the paper reports recovering reference phases more often and faster than Dara; it also demonstrates multiphase analysis for constant-wavelength and time-of-flight neutron data
resources.artifact_note: The implementation requires GSAS-II and a separately downloaded crystallographic database of about 2.3 GB

resources.name: Dara
resources.task: Multiple-hypothesis phase identification and Rietveld refinement from PXRD
resources.method: Database filtering + peak-matching-pruned tree search + BGMN full-profile refinement + isostructural grouping
resources.reported_result: Commercial precursor mixtures: 18/20 correct for 2-minute scans and 20/20 for 8-minute scans; 2,453 deployed analyses had median runtime 88.9 s and median best-fit Rwp 5.85%
resources.artifact_note: The open Dara package uses the external BGMN refinement engine and requires a user-supplied structure database; access restrictions depend on the selected database

resources.name: Automated Interpretation Framework (AIF)
resources.task: Probabilistic ranking and trust assessment of competing PXRD phase interpretations
resources.method: Bayesian combination of Rwp/peak-match evidence, composition balance, and LLM-derived chemical-plausibility priors
resources.reported_result: In 30 blinded cases with a clear expert preference, evaluators selected AIF's top interpretation over the lowest-Rwp baseline in 93% of cases (95% CI 78-98%); trust decisions agreed with experts in about 75-80%
resources.artifact_note: The repository declares no software license and depends on Dara, an ICSD-backed structure database, and CBORG/OpenAI-compatible model access

resources.name: AutoXRD
resources.task: Autonomous powder-diffraction analysis, staged Rietveld workflow execution, and evidence-based result validation
resources.method: LLM agent runtime with reusable XRD procedures, FullProf/GSAS-II backends, deterministic pre/post checks, and append-only refinement trajectories
resources.reported_result: Across 1,340 runs on ten language models, the paper reports a mean score of 57.8/100, decreasing from 61.9 on 100 diagnostic tasks to 53.7 on 34 executable end-to-end workflows; all six framework-component ablations reduced performance
resources.artifact_note: Source code and tests are public, but the repository declares no software license and has no tagged release; full refinement requires a model API key and separately configured FullProf and/or GSAS-II backends

resources.name: PhaseDifformer
resources.task: Multi-phase PXRD decomposition
resources.method: Phase-decomposition diffusion Transformer
resources.reported_result: Decomposes a single mixed PXRD pattern into constituent single-phase patterns; useful as a front-end for mixture analysis before structure solution

resources.name: RAPID
resources.task: CNN initialization and automated FullProf Rietveld refinement from PXRD
resources.method: Convolutional neural network trained on augmented simulated profiles to predict structure/profile parameters, followed by AutoFP/FullProf refinement
resources.reported_result: Demonstrated refined structures for CeO₂, Tb₂BaCoO₅, and PbSO₄ with reliability factors comparable to conventional Rietveld refinement
resources.artifact_note: GPL-3.0 code is public; the current workflow is Windows-only and requires separate Python 2.7 and 3.11 environments plus AutoFP/FullProf

resources.name: GALAXI experimental benchmark
resources.size: 128 public XY files; paper describes 130 experimental test patterns
resources.format: XY profiles + reference CIFs + model configurations
resources.notes: The public example includes 365 reference CIFs and artifact-grouped patterns. The paper separates 61 pristine patterns from 69 stress tests; the inspected snapshot has 128 XY files, so full paper-cohort completeness is not established. Phase labels occur in filenames and must be hidden in blind evaluation

resources.name: RealBind
resources.size: 3,288 structures; 1,468 measured PXRD queries; 16,005 measured Raman spectra
resources.format: CSV manifests + NPZ arrays + trained checkpoints + rebuild/evaluation code
resources.notes: Leakage-controlled, single-phase structure-retrieval benchmark with prototype- and composition-held-out splits. On its 492-candidate prototype-held-out PXRD library, the preprint reports Recall@10 of 78.5% for simulated queries but 5.3% for measured queries from the same baseline; model-free masked correlation reaches 82.8%. The MIT/CC-BY-4.0 release includes per-query protocols, results, a miniature smoke test, and checkpoints, but opXRD/RRUFF-derived measured arrays must be rebuilt under their source terms. The bundled 104-query smoke test passed in this audit; full-data results were checked against release metadata but not rerun

resources.name: XRDBench
resources.notes: Powder-diffraction agent benchmark spanning diagnostic reasoning and 11 end-to-end task families; the 34 measured-pattern workflows include 30 X-ray and 4 neutron cases. Published snapshots include evaluator-only oracles and must be excluded from blind solver workspaces

resources.name: hMOF-100 / hMOF-400
resources.notes: Hypothetical MOF benchmarks used by XtalNet

resources.name: MP-20-PXRD
resources.format: Pickled PyTorch tensors with structures and precomputed unbroadened PXRD
resources.notes: PXRDnet's released modification of MP-20 with calculated powder patterns; despite the .csv filenames, the Git LFS objects are pickle files containing PyTorch tensors. PXRDnet uses this release, while PXRDGen starts from the same MP-20 structures and generates different GSAS-II powder patterns

resources.name: XRDSol MP-20 / ICDD-20 benchmarks
resources.notes: XRDSol training/evaluation; ICDD/PDF content may require database access

resources.name: JARVIS-DFT structures / JARVIS-XRD simulator
resources.format: Computed-structure database / API plus XRD simulation module
resources.notes: JARVIS-DFT supplies computed structures and JARVIS-Tools supplies XRD simulation; this is supporting infrastructure rather than a standalone PXRD benchmark. DiffractGPT reports training on simulated patterns from JARVIS-DFT structures

resources.name: CHILI-3K / CHILI-100K
resources.format: Graph/HDF5 finite nanomaterial structures with simulated total-scattering channels
resources.notes: Retained as supporting structure substrate because deCIFer evaluates on about 8,200 periodic CHILI-100K CIFs and calculates Bragg PXRD from them. CHILI's own Debye-equation XRD channel describes finite-cluster total scattering and is not the in-scope pathway

resources.name: SimXRD-4M
resources.notes: Large crystal-symmetry prediction benchmark with 33 simulated conditions

resources.name: SIMPOD
resources.notes: COD-derived benchmark for PXRD ML; simulated 2θ range 5–90° with 10,824 points and radial-image representation

resources.name: RealPXRD-Solver training corpus
resources.format: d-I fingerprints, simulated/augmented PXRD, code/data links
resources.notes: AFLOW + Materials Project + Alexandria + OQMD-scale corpus with experiment-mimicking augmentations; evaluated on CNRS, RRUFF, and PDF entries

resources.name: AlphaDiffract simulation corpus
resources.size: >31M simulated PXRD from 312,267 structures in paper; open MP-only model subset also available
resources.format: Simulated PXRD, labels for lattice / symmetry
resources.notes: Crystal system, space group, and lattice parameter benchmark; open model/data are smaller and based on public Materials Project structures

resources.name: XQueryer simulated database
resources.format: Simulated patterns, matching database, benchmark scripts
resources.notes: Neural search-match and real-time identification; includes RRUFF-MP matching benchmark

resources.name: PowBase
resources.notes: Historical experimental PXRD collection; limited labels

resources.name: Crystallography Open Database structure source
resources.notes: COD is primarily an open crystal-structure database used by SIMPOD and XRD-Rust for simulated-PXRD generation and by xrdkit for candidate search. Structure factors or powder diffractograms are optional per-entry deposits, so this row does not claim a defined experimental-PXRD subset

resources.name: RRUFF
resources.size: Mineral spectra collection; current PXRD subset count not reverified
resources.notes: Reference mineral Raman/IR/XRD data used for experimental transfer; the new official portal is still under construction. Replaces rruff.info, which redirected to the unrelated Gale Crater database during this audit

resources.name: XRed
resources.size: 100+ public pattern files in GitHub tree
resources.notes: Public experimental XRD phase-identification dataset with mono-, bi-, tri-, and multi-phase examples

resources.name: opXRD
resources.notes: Open experimental PXRD database sourced from six contributing institutions; useful for experimental-domain adaptation and retrieval

resources.name: opXRD-HKUST and literature experimental PXRD
resources.size: 1,277 patterns: 261 selected opXRD HKUST-B samples plus literature data
resources.notes: Open experimental PXRD collection hosted by Bin Cao: 261 selected, labeled samples from opXRD's 499-pattern HKUST-B set plus additional patterns retrieved from the literature. Patterns were filtered for low noise and narrow resolved peaks, then background-subtracted; the card recommends curated opXRD or RRUFF releases for standardized benchmarking. The XCCP paper cites this collection as an experimental data artifact

resources.name: pymatgen XRDCalculator
resources.task: PXRD simulation from CIF / structure
resources.notes: Widely used baseline for simulated pattern generation

resources.name: GSAS-II
resources.task: Rietveld refinement and diffraction analysis
resources.notes: Standard open-source crystallographic refinement package; also used for simulation in ML data generation

resources.name: PowderLine
resources.task: Programmatic Rietveld refinement and single-peak fitting
resources.notes: Encodes a full refinement as a versioned declarative JSON recipe and returns structured results through GSAS-II, TOPAS v7, or EasyDiffraction; the paper's two-phase worked example reports Rwp = 8.46%. Hosted and repository-local documentation are available

resources.name: PyXplore / PyWPEM
resources.task: Whole-pattern effect modelling, PXRD simulation/decomposition, and structure/profile preprocessing
resources.notes: MIT Python package with PyPI release 2026.9.18. Its WPEM workflow supports structure and profile refinement but still requires an initial structure/CIF; the broader package also covers XPS and EXAFS. Paper benchmarks are author-reported and were not reproduced in this audit

resources.name: xrdkit
resources.task: PXRD ingestion, candidate matching, and scripted Le Bail/Rietveld workflows
resources.notes: MIT Python package with XRDML/XY/XYE readers, COD candidate matching, and a separate GSAS-II refinement driver. PyPI v0.2.0 is available; matching requires an element set and refinement requires starting structures/instrument parameters. No bundled benchmark data or peer-reviewed performance claim; API remains under active development

resources.name: XRD-Rust
resources.task: Fast PXRD simulation
resources.notes: Rust-accelerated pymatgen-style XRD calculator; the paper reports median serial-SIMD speedups of 10.7× on COD and 10.8× on MC3D, increasing to 19.5× and 15.1× with eight threads

resources.name: XRDStudio
resources.task: Browser-based PXRD simulation and phase-pattern comparison
resources.notes: Single-file local app with 171 bundled structures, CIF import, multiple radiation choices, overlays, and reflection export; it does not perform refinement or model texture, absorption, or size/strain broadening
